rationale.overall: B better preserves the reference’s subdued textured surfaces and dimensional lighting, while A’s dense crosshatching feels overly artificial.
rationale.material: B’s softer surface texture, richer bar reflections, and more natural background shading read closer to the reference’s material depth.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes use essentially the same bar, loop, and rounded-square silhouettes with equally minor departures from the reference.
rationale.smallsize: At 128px, 32px, and 16px, both takes retain nearly identical object recognition, contrast, and orange-edge readability.
